source: Not a book section. The plan, build and playtest shape follows CodeHS's project modules in Introduction to Game Design; the Breakout idea follows Video Game Design in JavaScript's Breakout ladder. Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Plan, and a ball you move yourself
lessons.objective: Students will be able to plan a game as parts and remembered values, and move and bounce a sprite with two speed variables.

lessons.title: The paddle and the bounce
lessons.objective: Students will be able to steer a paddle with the mouse or the keys, keep it on screen, and bounce a ball off three walls and the paddle.

lessons.title: Bricks, and the ball's edges
lessons.objective: Students will be able to build a wall from rows of text, draw it from the data, and test the ball's four edge points against it.

lessons.title: Win, lose and pick a mode
lessons.objective: Students will be able to end a game on bricks left and lives, and pick a mode on a key-press title screen.

lessons.title: Playtest, check, and make it yours
lessons.objective: Students will be able to playtest their own game, link what they saw to their code, and extend it with a rule of their own.
